glosses: eine Person oder einen Gegenstand aus etwas herausholen

examples.text: „Sie angelten. Ich habe nie, wirklich niemals gesehen, daß einer von diesen Männern je etwas anderes aus dem Wasser herausfischte als seinen eigenen Köder.“

translations.source_sense_description: eine Person oder einen Gegenstand aus etwas herausholen

glosses: To catch all or nearly all the fish in (a given body of water), so that few or none remain.

examples.text: Settlers came and soon fished out the lake.

glosses: To pick up or pull something or someone from (a body of water).

examples.text: Losing nearly a third of the heavy cruisers, including Admiral Kurita's flagship, the Atago, was not an especially-auspicious start to the operation, especially with the admiral himself having to be fished out of the water by a destroyer.

glosses: To search for by rummaging, and then extract (an item from e.g. a container); to obtain.

examples.text: I fished out my keys from the bottom of my bag.
I fished out some information from some old copies of the local gazette.
